scope: Bounded semantic review of eight CEE offers and regression fixes identified on 2026-10-15. This is not a fresh semantic verification of every offer.

primary_evidence.finding: 100 CZK monthly fee waived strictly above 100000 CZK monthly turnover; card 0.67% + 1 CZK, Czech bank transfer 0.62%.
Standard post-introductory 0.95% + 0 CZK; 80 CZK monthly operating fee applies only up to 50000 CZK turnover.
30 EUR minimum licence includes processing charges. Card components total 1.8% + 0.06 EUR; IBAN 1.1% + 0.02 EUR. Published prices exclude VAT.

Waiver expired 2026-09-30. Standard monthly SoftPOS 990 HUF, VPOS 3500 HUF. For 20 EUR domestic debit, SoftPOS Visa 0.078% + 0.04 EUR / Mastercard 0.103% + 0.04 EUR; VPOS Visa 0.078% + 0.06 EUR / Mastercard 0.126% + 0.05 EUR. Paired scheme scenarios are preserved.

regression_controls: Normalise economic fields before final calculation/export.
Compare actual browser calculations against every exported offer before publication.
Check strict waiver boundary after currency conversion.
Label nonzero promotional rates as promotional.

pending.issue: Other conditional recurring fees and partial-component monthly minima need individual semantic review.
OTP Hungary promotion extension and other time-limited offers require separate current-source review.
Full-source audit availability/mismatch results are not yet propagated to dashboard monitoring summary.
